name: computer/organise-folder
title: Sort a folder
summary: Sort a messy folder into dated or typed subfolders: list, plan, make folders, move; nothing is deleted.
when: Use when a downloads or documents folder is a flat mess and the user wants it sorted into subfolders.
steps: Call list_files on the folder and write down every file name, size and date before moving anything.
Group the files by type or by year and month and write the planned folder name next to each file.
Call file_manage action mkdir once for each folder in the plan, using a flat name such as 2026-11 or invoices.
Call file_manage action move with path and destination for each file, keeping its original name.
If the destination name is taken, call file_manage action move to a name with a date suffix instead of replacing anything.
Call list_files on the folder again and compare the total with the first listing so no file went missing.
Leave any file that fits no group where it is, and say which files those are at the end.
Report the folders made, the files moved and the files left alone; nothing on disk changed beyond the moves.
next: The final answer must list the folders created, how many files went into each and which files were left where they were.
